links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy and clinical reasoning quality (R-IDEA) of LLMs on rare primary immune disorder vignettes
links.effect: Three models had accuracy >88% and R-IDEA ≥8 (GPT-4o 96.2%); the other three had accuracy near 60% or lower and R-IDEA ≤0.55 (Mistral-7B 42.3%).
links.quote: Conversely, the remaining 3 models fell below acceptable accuracy rates near 60% or lower and had poor R-IDEA scores (≤0.55), with Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 attaining the worst diagnostic accuracy (42.3%).

screen.reason: Evaluates diagnostic accuracy and clinical reasoning scores of 6 LLMs using anonymized clinical vignettes without evaluating a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
